what_went_right: Detected 215 boxes across 8 pilot images; recognized persons motorbikes cars bicycles trucks and buses; detected the red bus in img_030 correctly
what_went_wrong: Missed three-wheelers in img_002 and img_032; several boxes overlap in crowded scenes; some vehicle boundaries and classes need review
decision: Use as a recall-oriented pre-label baseline; manually correct boxes and combine with YOLOE for three_wheeler

what_went_right: Retained many clear detections; reduced total boxes by 76 compared with conf=0.25; preserved large vehicles and the bus in img_030
what_went_wrong: Filtered some small and occluded persons and motorbikes; three-wheelers remain undetected; crowded scenes still contain overlapping boxes
decision: Prefer conf=0.25 when prioritizing recall; use conf=0.50 for comparison and filtering; review manually before accepting labels

what_went_right: Detected the green tuk-tuk in img_002 and three cyclos in img_032; recognized three-wheelers that YOLO26 did not classify correctly
what_went_wrong: Possible false positives on a motorcycle and pickup truck in img_002 and a large vehicle at the left edge of img_011; some boxes have inaccurate boundaries; recall has not been measured against ground truth
decision: Use YOLOE as a complementary source for three_wheeler pre-labels; manually remove false positives and adjust box boundaries in CVAT; do not accept all predictions automatically

what_went_right: Generated 16 boxes and 16 segmentation masks across img_004 and img_013; masks captured visible vehicle shapes and several persons more precisely than rectangular boxes
what_went_wrong: Tuk-tuks were misclassified as car; the prominent blue tuk-tuk in img_004 lacked a clear vehicle detection; the large tuk-tuk in img_013 had an incomplete box and mask; some occluded person masks were fragmented
decision: Use SAM 2.1 to refine segmentation after checking detection boxes and classes; correct tuk-tuks to three_wheeler and manually review missing objects and inaccurate mask boundaries
